exposure: Reason for not using ITN due to the use of other preventive measures
cohort: The study participants were 140 pregnant women attending antenatal care at the Ejisu Government Hospital in Ghana.
finding: Malaria infection was significantly associated with sleeping under ITN, the use of insecticide mosquito spray, and not using ITN due to the use of other preventive measures.
